descripcion_geo: City or region in the north of Edom, famous for its wise men. In the oracles of the prophets it is synonymous with Edom.
importancia_estrategica: Spiritual capital of Edom; seat of Edomite wisdom cited in the prophets.

historias.titulo: Eliphaz the Temanite: friend of Job
historias.descripcion: Eliphaz the Temanite is the most important of the three friends who visit Job; It comes from the wise Temán.
Jeremiah, Ezekiel and Obadiah prophesied against Teman as a symbol of Edom: his wisdom and pride will be destroyed.
The prophet Habakkuk describes the theophany of God marching from Teman and Mount Paran with a glory that covers the heavens.

personajes.descripcion: The wisest of Job's friends; his correct but inapplicable theology is corrected by God in the end.
He described God marching from Teman as an image of his irresistible power.
He asked sarcastically: 'Is there no wisdom in Temán anymore?' when prophesying against Edom.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Teman: relevant geographic region in the Old Testament.

judaismo.descripcion: Teman was famous for its wise men (Jer 49:7); Eliphaz the Temanite represents the best human wisdom that still fails in the face of the mystery of Job's suffering.
judaismo.significado_teologico: Teman was famous for its wise men (Jer 49:7); Eliphaz the Temanite represents the best human wisdom that still fails in the face of the mystery of Job's suffering.
